description: Attach a tag to one or more resources. If the tag key already exists on a resource, only its value is updated.

nrnList.description: List of Ncloud Resource Names to tag (see ncloud_resource_list_resources)

tagKey.description: Tag key to attach (1-128 chars; the special characters _ . / = + - @ are allowed)

tagValue.description: Tag value to attach (1-256 chars; the special characters _ . / = + - @ are allowed)

name: ncloud_resource_attach_tag
